overview: Art of Animation is a Value resort themed to animated films, and most of its rooms are Family Suites. It shares the Skyliner station with Pop Century.
suits: Families of five or six who want a suite with room to spread out, at a lower price than a Moderate or Deluxe resort.
rooms: Most rooms are Family Suites that sleep up to six, with a separate bedroom, two bathrooms and a kitchenette. There are also standard rooms that sleep four.
pools: The Big Blue Pool is the main pool and one of the largest at Walt Disney World, with underwater speakers. There are two smaller pools in other sections.
dining: Dining is the Landscape of Flavors food court, with a pool bar nearby. There's no table-service restaurant.
pros: Family Suites with a kitchenette and two bathrooms
Skyliner access to Epcot and Hollywood Studios
cons: Suites cost more than standard Value rooms
Buses to Magic Kingdom and Animal Kingdom
tips: Compare a suite with two Value rooms; the suite's extra bathroom is a big plus for families.
The Skyliner station is a short walk from the main building.
bestFor: Families of five or six who want a suite.
